source.title: Department of Education section (Table-5 OVER-CAP sub-split, page 12), unit 2 of 2: the department-level remainder + the grand roll-up to Total--Department of Education. Holds the flat department-direct lines (Office of Innovation and Improvement, Office of English Language Acquisition, the three Office of Special Education and Rehabilitative Services lines, Office of Vocational and Adult Education, Institute of Education Sciences, Departmental Management, Other, Proprietary Receipts, Intrabudgetary Transactions) plus the THREE bureau Total-- rows RE-ANCHORED (re-read from source, never copied) from the sibling unit -education-bureaus, so the department roll-up self-verifies. Re-anchor pattern: the Table-4 receipts slices (-receipts-si-remainder).
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted). This is the second of two units splitting the over-cap Department of Education section. The three bureau Total-- rows (Office of Elementary and Secondary Education, Office of Postsecondary Education, Office of Federal Student Aid) are RE-ANCHORED here as leaves -- re-read from the page-12 render, never copied from the sibling -education-bureaus unit -- so that Total--Department of Education can be verified. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Nine-column model. The department Applicable column is single-source at This-Month (c2) and Prior-FYTD (c8) -- only 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public' carries an applicable there -- so those two Proprietary applicable cells are 'standalone' with a why, and the Total--Department of Education c2/c8 cells are covered by the total-row net identity. The CFYTD applicable column (c5) has two sources (Total--Office of Federal Student Aid re-anchored, and Proprietary) and rolls up. Intrabudgetary Transactions omits its CFYTD cells ('(**)'). Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.'
